pages.text: $(4)Read this and do not do it.$()$(br2)There is a ninth phase. It is not reached by neglect: someone must choose it. Burn the $(l)Heart of the Pestilence$() on a lit pyre, at night, while the Pale Rider rides, and do it twice; the first time the Heart only warns you.

pages.title: The Black Bloom
pages.text: Where the Heart burns, the $(l)Black Bloom$() takes root. It never moves. Every few seconds it pulses, and those near it catch the Blackblight; it raises pustules and blackens the earth wider the longer it lives.$(br2)Fire hurts it twice over. Bring fire.

pages.title: The sickness
pages.text: The Blackblight has $(4)ten stages, and the tenth is death$(). Each stage takes half a heart; darkness, weakness, slowness and withering come in turn. The far gone pass it to those beside them; a mask only halves the risk, and the Plaguebane Amulet does nothing.$(br2)$(l)Theriac$() sets it back two stages (curing it in the first two).

pages.title: The end of it
pages.text: Kill the Black Bloom and the Blackblight lifts from everyone at once, and the Pestilence itself is broken: every phase, back to nothing.$(br2)Some worlds forbid it: the Vanilla+ preset, or $(l)allowBlackblight$() in the config.
